title: thelypteris cordata
intro: Thelypteris cordata, commonly known as the American maidenhair fern, is a species of fern that belongs to the family Thelypteridaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include relief from respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Thelypteris cordata include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe and protect the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
